name: runbrief

tools.name: publish_artifact
tools.description: Publish self-contained HTML, Markdown, or a local site/ZIP as a Restricted artifact. Set presentation.chrome to content-only for a full viewport with every Brief control hidden. Returns its private link and artifactId.

workspaceId.description: Connected Brief workspace; omit when the connector has one workspace.

content.description: Complete self-contained source. Provide content or sourcePath, not both. Classic scripts and self-contained Vite module entries are supported; real module imports, remote resources, and network access stay blocked.

sourcePath.description: Literal repo-relative .html, .md, .zip, or site-folder path. Site folders and ZIPs need index.html. Brief bundles them locally and never sends the path.

tools.name: update_artifact
tools.description: Append an immutable artifact version with expected-version safety. Set presentation.chrome to content-only for a full viewport with every Brief control hidden; then read comments with get_artifact_comments.

content.description: Complete replacement source. Provide content or sourcePath, not both. Self-contained Vite module entries are supported; real module imports and network access stay blocked.

sourcePath.description: Literal repo-relative .html, .md, .zip, or site-folder path. Site folders and ZIPs need index.html. Brief bundles them locally and never sends the path.

tools.name: share_artifact
tools.description: Change artifact access to Restricted, workspace, named people, or an explicit revocable expiring link.

audience.description: General access change. Named people are independent and do not weaken existing general access.

confirmExternalShare.description: Must be true to create a revocable expiring link that can open without login.

tools.name: get_artifact_comments
tools.description: Read page-wide, text-anchored, or element-anchored comments with complete replies, open or resolved status, review decisions, and a cursor for the next check.

artifactId.description: The stable Brief artifact ID returned by publish_artifact or update_artifact.

after.description: For a follow-up check, pass summary.nextCursor from the previous response. Omit on the first call.

version.description: Review one immutable version. Omit to read comments and decisions across every version.

tools.name: frontend_proof
tools.description: Prove a frontend change without replacing the coding agent. The before action runs an explicit local browser or verification command and captures repo-relative artifacts. Optionally provide an assertion manifest so Brief verifies named scenarios and assertions instead of treating screenshots alone as semantic proof. The after action replays the exact command, captures the same paths, and writes a local-only before/after HTML report. Keep credentials outside the command and review screenshots for sensitive data before sharing.

repoPath.description: Path inside the repo. Defaults to BRIEF_REPO_ROOT captured from the agent workspace, then current working directory.

command.description: Explicit local verification command for before. Brief stores and replays this exact command for after; do not embed credentials.

artifactPaths.description: Repo-relative files or directories produced by the command, such as test-results/frontend-proof.

assertionManifestPath.description: Optional repo-relative JSON manifest produced by the command. Version 1 contains named scenarios with passed/failed status, boolean assertions, and optional captured artifact paths. When present, after verification requires every before scenario and assertion to pass again.

evidenceManifestPath.description: Optional repo-relative Brief V2 manifest or Playwright JSON report. The before phase stores only validated semantic evidence; after compares the same route, fixture, viewport, and assertion contract.

requiredScenarios.description: Optional named states the assertion manifest must cover in both phases, such as loaded, empty, menu-open, and modal-open.

requirePopulatedEvidence.description: When true, the manifest must include a populated dataState scenario so an empty screen cannot satisfy the proof contract.

tools.name: install_status
tools.description: First Brief call once per agent session. Confirms MCP is connected to the correct repo/worktree, scans it, and, when task is provided, returns the first compact context packet plus the exact next action. Micro and small tasks can proceed from that packet without calling brief.next. Never needs a reusable API key.

repoPath.description: Path inside the repo. Defaults to BRIEF_REPO_ROOT captured from the agent workspace, then current working directory.

detail.description: Defaults to compact. Use "expanded" only when you need the full run contract, receipts, or proof markdown.

task.description: The user's current task, when already known. Brief returns a compact first context packet and routing decision in this same call; do not call brief.next when activation.followUpRequired is false.

routing.description: Optional current runtime and user controls. Omit when unknown; Brief stays quiet rather than inventing a switch.

tools.name: restart_connector
tools.description: Recover a stale Brief MCP connector. Without confirmation it returns exact steps; with confirm: "restart brief mcp" it exits this local MCP process so hosts that supervise MCP subprocesses can relaunch it fresh.

surface.description: The host surface whose restart steps should be returned. Defaults to auto.

confirm.description: Set to "restart brief mcp" to schedule this MCP process to exit after returning recovery instructions.

force.description: Allow a confirmed restart even when Brief currently appears fresh.

missionId.description: Optional Mission State V2 id. When enabled, safeToOpen is gated by the latest digest-bound mission scope and proofs.

mode.description: Review depth. Lightweight is the fast deterministic path; full adds adaptive risk-lens coverage, validation gaps, noise routing, and explicit unproven claims.

maxFiles.description: Interactive scan budget. Defaults to 500 files and prioritizes reviewed paths; partial coverage is reported by the map proof gate.

enabledGates.description: Optional review gates to run. Defaults to bug bar, tests, runtime evidence, map proof, secrets, pre-coding context, required rules, and cross-agent review.

source.description: Where the runtime evidence came from.

runtimeEvidence.description: Optional Sentry, Datadog, CI, log, trace, incident, or manual evidence for the runtime_evidence review gate.

validationEvidence.description: Optional validation commands already run for the diff. Passed evidence can satisfy map-proof validation requirements.

mapUtilityDecisions.description: Explicit decisions for map recommendations shown before coding. Reuse recommendations should be used, adapted, ruled out, or marked not applicable.

referenceDecisions.description: Decisions for every routed reference pack. Used/adapted decisions need evidence; ruled-out/not-applicable decisions need a reason.

referenceMigrationProof.description: Proof for a reference-driven migration mission. Every planned page × theme × viewport case needs evidence.

referenceConvergenceProof.description: Content-addressed proof for a complete reference-driven rollout. Unverified targets, stale contract digests, unapproved exceptions, or incomplete inventory fail the conformance gate.

severityThreshold.description: Lowest severity to include in the returned findings.

requirePreCodingContext.description: When false, skips the missing pre-coding context receipt finding.

requireDifferentAgent.description: When true, the cross_agent gate requires authorAgent and reviewerAgent to be present and different.

authorAgent.description: Agent or surface that authored the diff, such as Claude Code.

reviewerAgent.description: Independent agent or surface that reviewed the diff.

instructions:
Brief: do not wait for 'use Brief'.
First non-trivial task: brief.install_status with task and known routing runtime only. activation is the route; if followUpRequired is false use its packet, else its recommendation.
Skip Brief for simple operational or read-only requests.
Call brief.next after scope or validation changes. If mcpTool is none, use one packet plus focused validation; do not repeat start calls. Escalate on scope, failure, or trust boundaries.
Use modelRouting when present; absence means stay single-agent. Use brief.model_route only at material checkpoints. Never claim model or fan-out execution before host confirmation; user controls win.
Reuse first. Local work continues; do not narrate background refreshes.
UI: brief.frontend_proof before/after.
PR/human handoff: brief.review_diff; verify risky or multi-step proof.
Recap benefit plus validation or risk in 1-2 lines.
